name: migrate

name: seed

name: query-plan

name: restore
description: Restore the production database from a chosen snapshot after explicit human confirmation of the target point.

name: unit

name: e2e

name: integration

name: coverage

name: readme

name: api

name: tutorial

name: architecture

name: docstrings

name: link-check
description: Scan documentation pages for broken internal and external links and list the failures.

name: staging

name: production

name: rollback

name: preview

name: status
description: Show which version of each service is currently running in every environment.

name: smoke-test

name: security

name: style

name: summarize-diff

name: publish

name: clean
